feeding_claim.verbatim: We are a 100% forage based system. Our animals have been born and raised on grass on our farm. We do not grain finish.

pickup_locations: Potts Family Meats, 161 Elliot Smith Rd, Jefferson, GA (processor)

availability.note: Waitlist for 2026 beef shares is open; the farm aims to fill requests within a year.

notes: Sells whole and half beef shares by waitlist and deposit ($500 whole, $300 half). Buyers pick up at the processor; the farm does not deliver. FAQ also mentions quarter shares (split half). Phone is written out in words on the site.
